title: Recording timeline
description: Monotonic-clock timeline of one recording (D15, E15). Events carry no wall clock; wall time comes only from the anchors, each pairing a wall-clock reading with the monotonic clock of the same boot. A resume closes the most recent pause, interrupted or silenced span. The recording's audio_segment Attachments number their seq from 0 in recording order. Open; capture.commit closes it.

boot_id.description: Identifier of the device boot the monotonic clock belongs to; mono_ns values from different boots are not comparable.

start_uncertainty_ms.description: How far the recorded start may be off, when the recorder cannot report its own start timestamp.

mono_ns.description: Monotonic clock (Android elapsedRealtimeNanos) as int64; values above 2^53 occur, so decoders must not go through a double.
